description.en: Required to play .fds disk images. The core refuses to start one without it, and rejects a file that is not exactly 8 KiB. Cartridge (.nes) and music (.nsf) files do not need it.

Optional. A pack of alternative NES colour palettes, selectable from the in-game options menu. Without it the core uses its built-in default palette and the palette option offers no alternatives; nothing else changes. Each entry is a 288-byte record (a 32-byte name followed by 64 RGB colours).
